question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blanks: I_____you to plant the seed, water it and come back here.
solution:
The correct answer is '**want**'.
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The verb "**want**" is used in its base form to match the subject "I," which requires a first-person singular verb form.
 
• Option 2 ("wants") is incorrect because "wants" is used with third-person singular subjects, not first-person.
